title: Dashboard Launch Cockpit
description: The dashboard (`bun run dashboard`, `semio …`) is the only developer control plane: no launch.json anywhere, every runnable thing declared next to its owner, configs derived and drift-checked, battle tested across the monorepo.

Stronger independent absolute caret replay passed. Current release freshness verified. Owned instances stopped, authored evidence retained, generated outputs removed. Native Linux/macOS runtime and execution of every destructive command are not claimed. See the final verification report.
